name: Kite
summary: Lets an AI agent design in a shared file: it draws real, editable layers (frames, text, components, auto layout) your team edits and comments on live, and can copy any frame as HTML, React or Tailwind.
license: Plugin repository MIT; the hosted Kite service is under the Kite terms (https://kite.new/terms)

distribution.label: Hosted MCP server
distribution.scope: Remote Streamable HTTP MCP server with OAuth sign-in. The repository holds the Claude Code, Codex and Cursor plugin packaging (server entry plus the Kite skill), which is optional.

installation.title: Add the server to any MCP client
installation.body: Add Kite as a remote MCP server (custom connector in Claude, ChatGPT or Grok). The first call opens Kite in the browser to sign in or create a free account and allow access. Headless clients can send a Bearer API key created in Kite Settings instead.
installation.label: Kite MCP docs

installation.title: Or install the Claude Code plugin
installation.body: The plugin adds the same hosted server and the Kite design skill. Then run /mcp, choose kite and sign in.

installation.title: Or install the Codex plugin
installation.body: Add the marketplace, then install Kite from /plugins and sign in when asked.

manual_setup: A Kite account (free plan: unlimited editors, 3 files and a daily cap on agent actions; Pro removes the caps). Sign-in happens once in the browser; no key to paste for OAuth clients.
notes: Kite sells no AI credits: the agent runs on the plan you already use. Design files are stored in your Kite workspace; you can disconnect an agent any time in Kite settings (https://kite.new/privacy).
